properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded HMAC signing key used by JwtUtil to sign and verify JWTs. Override in application-local.yml; never commit a real value.

properties.name: jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT token lifetime in milliseconds. Defaults to 86400000 (24 hours).

properties.name: external-api.football-data.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the football-data.org v4 REST API. Used by ExternalApiService.

properties.name: external-api.football-data.api-key
properties.description: API key for football-data.org (sent as the X-Auth-Token header). Override in application-local.yml; never commit a real value.

properties.name: external-api.nba.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for ESPN's unofficial public NBA API. Used by NbaApiService for teams, rosters, and scoreboards. No API key required.

properties.name: external-api.nba.standings-url
properties.description: Base URL for ESPN's NBA standings endpoint (lives on a different subdomain than the main API). Used by NbaApiService.

properties.name: external-api.nfl.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for ESPN's unofficial public NFL API. Used by NflApiService for teams, rosters, and scoreboards. No API key required.

properties.name: external-api.nfl.standings-url
properties.description: Base URL for ESPN's NFL standings endpoint (lives on apis/v2, not apis/site/v2 — same pattern as NBA). Used by NflApiService.fetchStandings(). Defaults to https://site.api.espn.com/apis/v2/sports/football/nfl.

properties.name: external-api.balldontlie.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the balldontlie.io v1 REST API. Used by BallDontLieService to fetch NBA player bio data (height, weight, college, draft info). Defaults to https://api.balldontlie.io/v1.

properties.name: external-api.balldontlie.api-key
properties.description: API key for balldontlie.io (sent as the Authorization header — no Bearer prefix). Free tier gives access to /players and /teams at 5 req/min. Override in application-local.yml; never commit a real value.
